description: This Java source file contains utility methods for managing Android SDKs within an IDE environment, including SDK creation, configuration, validation, and integration with project modules.

classes.name: AndroidSdkUtils
classes.description: A utility class providing methods for managing Android SDKs within an IDE, including creation, configuration, validation, and integration.

methods.name: getPlatformDir
methods.description: Retrieves the platform directory for a given Android target.

methods.name: getPlatformAndAddOnJars
methods.description: Returns a list of VirtualFiles representing the platform and optional libraries JARs for a target.

methods.name: getLibraryRootsForTarget
methods.description: Constructs a list of OrderRoot objects for SDK libraries related to a target, including sources, documentation, and platform jars.

methods.name: findJavadocDir
methods.description: Finds the Javadoc directory within a given directory.

methods.name: addJavaDocAndSources
methods.description: Adds JavaDoc and source roots to a list of OrderRoots from a directory.

methods.name: getPresentableTargetName
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly name for an Android target.

methods.name: createNewAndroidPlatform
methods.description: Creates a new Android SDK in the IDE, prompting user for paths if necessary.

methods.name: findBestTarget
methods.description: Finds the best Android target based on API level from a given SDK path.

methods.name: createNewAndroidPlatform
methods.description: Creates a new SDK for a specified Android target and SDK path.

methods.name: chooseNameForNewLibrary
methods.description: Generates a default name for a new SDK library based on target.

methods.name: setUpSdk
methods.description: Configures an SDK with target info, roots, and additional data.

methods.name: findAndSetPlatformSources
methods.description: Finds and adds platform sources to SDK configuration.

methods.name: targetHasId
methods.description: Checks if a target has a specific ID string.

methods.name: getAndroidSdkPathsFromExistingPlatforms
methods.description: Returns paths of existing Android SDKs configured in the IDE.

methods.name: getAllAndroidSdks
methods.description: Returns all Android SDKs configured in the IDE.

methods.name: tryToSetAndroidPlatform
methods.description: Attempts to set a module's SDK to a given Android SDK if compatible.

methods.name: setupPlatform
methods.description: Sets up an Android SDK for a module based on stored properties or defaults.

methods.name: findSuitableAndroidSdk
methods.description: Finds an Android SDK matching a target hash string.

methods.name: getTargetHashStringFromPropertyFile
methods.description: Retrieves target hash string from project property file.

methods.name: findAndSetSdkWithHashString
methods.description: Finds and sets an SDK based on target hash string.

methods.name: findAndSetSdk
methods.description: Finds and sets an SDK for a module based on target hash and SDK path.

methods.name: tryToCreateAndSetAndroidSdk
methods.description: Attempts to create and set an Android SDK for a module.

methods.name: tryToCreateAndroidSdk
methods.description: Creates an Android SDK from a directory if possible.

methods.name: promptUserForSdkCreation
methods.description: Prompts user to select SDK and JDK paths for SDK creation.

methods.name: createNewAndroidPlatform
methods.description: Creates a new Android SDK given SDK and JDK paths.

methods.name: setupAndroidPlatformIfNecessary
methods.description: Ensures a module has a valid Android SDK, setting it up if needed.

methods.name: openModuleDependenciesConfigurable
methods.description: Opens module dependencies configuration UI.

methods.name: findAppropriateAndroidPlatform
methods.description: Finds an Android SDK matching a target and SDK data.

methods.name: isAndroidSdk
methods.description: Checks if a given SDK is an Android SDK.

methods.name: checkSdkRoots
methods.description: Validates SDK roots against a target for compatibility.

methods.name: getDebugBridge
methods.description: Retrieves the AndroidDebugBridge for a project.

methods.name: activateDdmsIfNecessary
methods.description: Activates or restarts DDMS if needed for debugging.

methods.name: canDdmsBeCorrupted
methods.description: Checks if DDMS is corrupted or devices are empty.

methods.name: isDdmsCorrupted
methods.description: Determines if DDMS is in a corrupted state.

methods.name: restartDdmlib
methods.description: Restarts the DDMLIB debugging service.

methods.name: isAndroidSdkAvailable
methods.description: Checks if an Android SDK is available.

methods.name: tryToChooseAndroidSdk
methods.description: Attempts to select an Android SDK automatically.

methods.name: setSdkData
methods.description: Sets the static SDK data reference.

methods.name: findPlatformSources
methods.description: Finds the source code folder for a given Android target.

methods.description: Returns the file path to the Android support repository.
